v: tri॰ apojalAni sanati dadAti sana--viw । jalawAtari “AzAQaM yutsu pftanAsu papriM svarzAmapsAmiti” f॰ 1, 91, 21, “apsAM jalAnAM dAtAram” BA॰ । “pavasva devamAdano vicarzaRirapsAH” f॰ 9, 84 ।
m: अप्सा See s.v.
अप्-सा mfn. (√ सन्), giving water, RV.

v: tri॰ apaH sanoti sana--qa । 1 apAM viSezaguRIBUte rase “pfTivyAH purIzamapsonAma” ya॰ 14, 4 । “apsonAmApAM sAraBUto rasa” iti vedadI॰ । Apa iva nirmalatayA sanyate saMbaDyate sana--bA॰ qa । 2 rUpe niru॰ ।
a: अप्सः --प्सा — m. --(प्साः) Ved. [अपःसनोति; सन्-ड] 1 Giving or yielding water; forming the essential portion of water (अपां सारभूतो रसः). --2 Not destroying. --प्सं Form, see अप्सस्.

s: strI, svarvveSyA । iti SabdaratnAvalI । (“striyAM bahuzvapsarasaH syAdEkatve'psarA api” । iti SabdArRave .)
v: strI apsaM rUpamastyasyAH prASastye kuYjA॰ ra । divyarUpavatyAM svarveSyAyAm “udBindatIM saMjayantImapsarAm” a॰ 4, 38, 1 ।

m: अप्सरा-पति m. ‘lord of the Apsarasas’, N. of the Gandharva Śikhaṇḍin, AV. iv, 37, 7.
अप्सराय Nom. Ā. अप्सरायते, to behave like an Apsaras, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 11 Comm.

v: strI apsarasa ivAcarati dehasOndaryyAdinA apsarasa + kyaN--salopaH karttari SAnac । apsarastulya sOndaryyavatyAM striyAm ।

m: अप्सरायित mfn. made or grown an Apsaras, Naiṣ.

a: अप्सरः — [अप्-सृ-अच्] Any aquatic animal (moving in water).

m: अप्सरः-पति m. ‘lord of the Apsarasas’, Indra, L.

v: strI ba॰ va॰ adByaH saranti udgacCanti sf--amun । samudrAnnissftAyAM svarveSyAyAm “apsunirmaTanAdeva rasAttasmAdvarastriyaH । utpeturmanujaSrezWa । tasmAdapsaraso 'Bavan” ityuktestAsAM taTAtvam । “ekApsaraHprArTitayorvivAdaH” raGuH “ArADito'dDA manurapsaroBiScakre prajAH svAH sanimezacihnAH” iti mAGaH । tAsAM ca nAwyakarmma vfttiH । tASca praDAnatayA dvAdaSa vahnipurARe darSitAH “urvvaSI menakA ramBA miSrakeSI hyalambuzA viSvAcI ca GftAcI ca paYcacUqA tilottamA BAnuvatyabalA ramyA dvAdaSApsarasaH SuBAH” iti gaRaBedanAmADyAye । atra SuBA iti viSezaRAt anyA api । tASca “urvaSI menakA ramBA GftAcI puYjikAsTalA sukeSI maYjuGozA ca mahAraNgavatIti ca” iti mA॰ pu॰ “aditirditirdanuH kAlA danAyuH siMhikA taTA । kroDA praDA ca viSvA ca vinatA kapilA muniH । kadruSca manujavyAGra । dakzakanyAstrayodaSa” iti kaSyapapatnIraBiDAya । “ityete devaganDarvvAH prADeyAH parikIrttitAH” iti ganDarvavaMSamaBiDAya ca “imaM tvapsarasAM vaMSaM viditaM puRyalakzaRam praDA'sUta mahABAgAdeva devarzitaH purA । alambuzA miSrakeSo vidyutparRA tilottamA । aruRA rakzitA cEva ramBA tadvanmanoramA । keSinI ca subAhuSca suratA surasA taTA । supriyA cAtibAhuSca” ityuktam BA॰ A॰ pa॰ । etAsAYca caturddaSotpatti sTAnAni ka dambaryyAM varRRitAni “yaTA vibuDasadmanyapasaraso nAma kanyakAH santIti tAsAM caturdaSa kulAni ekaM BagavataH kamalayonermanasaH samutpannam, anyadvedeByaH samBUtam, anyadagnerudBUtam anyat pavanAt prasUtam, anyadamftAnmaTyamAnAduTitam, anyajjalAjjAtam, anyadarkakiraReByo nirgatam, anyat somaraSmiByo nizpatitam, anyadBUmerudBUtam, anyat sOdAmanIByaH pravfttam, anyanmftyunA nirmitam, aparaM makaraketunA samutpAditam, anyattu dakzasya prajApateratipraBUtAnAM sutAnAM maDye dvO sute munirarizwA ca baBUvatuH, tAByAM ganDarvEH saha kuladvayaM jAtam evametAnyekatra caturdaSa kulAni” etanmUlaM tu vistaraBayAnnoktam । 2 diSi 3 upadiSi ca tayorjalahetutvAttaTAtvam “puYjikAsTalA ca kratuScApsarasAviti” ya॰ 15, 15, “puYjikAsTalA kratusTalA cApsarasO digupadigrUpe paricArike” iti vedadI॰ । “apsarasAviti dik ca upadik smAha” SrutestaTAtvam । “menakA vE apsarArUpiRIti” BAzyaprayogAt apsarasAviti Sruti nirdeSAcca nityabahuvacanAntatedyutsargaH kvacidekavacanAntatA'pi

m: अप्-सरस् See s.v.

अप्-सरस् आस् [RV.; AV. &c.], or अप्-सरा [AV. &c.], f. (fr. 2. अप् + √ सृ), ‘going in the waters or between the waters of the clouds’, a class of female divinities (sometimes called ‘nymphs’; they inhabit the sky, but often visit the earth; they are the wives of the Gandharvas (q.v.) and have the faculty of changing their shapes at will; they are fond of the water; one of their number, Rambhā, is said to have been produced at the churning of the ocean).
a: अप्सरस् — f. --(राः --रा). [अद्भ्यः सरंति उद्गच्छंति, सृ-असुन् Uṇ. 4. 236; cf. Rām. अप्सु निर्मथनादवे रसात्तस्माद्वरस्त्रियः . उत्पेतुर्मनुजश्रेष्ठ तस्मादप्सरसोऽभवन्] 1 A class of female divinities or celestial damsels who reside in the sky and are regarded as the wives of the Gandharvas. They are very fond of bathing, can change their shapes, and are endowed with superhuman power (प्रभाव). They are called स्वर्वेश्याः and are usually described as the servants of Indra, who, when alarmed by the rigorous austerities of some mighty sage, sends down one of them to disturb his penance, and her mission is generally successful; cf. या तपोविशेषपरिशंकितस्य सुकुमारं प्रहरणं महेंद्रस्य V. 1. They are also said to covet heroes who die gloriously on the battle-field; cf. R. 7. 53. Bāṇa mentions 14 different families of these nymphs (see K. 136). The word is usually said to be in pl. (स्त्रियां बहुष्वप्सरसः); but the singular, as also the form अप्सरा, sometimes occur; नियमविघ्नकारिणी मेनका नाम अप्सराः प्रेषिता Ś. 1; एकाप्सरः &c. R. 7. 53 and see Malli. thereon; अनप्सरेव प्रतिभासि V. 1. --2 Direction or the intermediate point of the compass (दिक् च उपदिक् च). --Comp. --तीर्थं N. of a sacred pool in which the Apsarasas bathe; probably it is the name of a place, see Ś. 6. --पतिः lord of the Apsarasas, epithet of Indra.

k.v: विद्याधराप्सरोयक्षरक्षोगन्धर्व किन्नराः। पिशाचो गुह्यकः सिद्धो भूतोऽमी देवयोनयः॥
स्त्रियां बहुष्वप्सरसः स्वर्वेश्या उर्वशीमुखाः। घृताची मेनका रम्भा उर्वशी च तिलोत्तमा। सुकेशीमञ्जुघोषाद्याः कथ्यम्तेऽप्सरसो बुधैः। हाहा हूहूश्चैवमाद्या गन्धर्वास्त्रिदिवौकसाम्.।

s: strI, (adByaH samudrajaleByaH saranti udyAnti, ap + sf + asun .) svarvveSyAH । urvvaSImenakAdyAH । bahuvacanAnto'yaM SabdaH । ityamaraH ॥ (“apsu nirmaTanAdeva rasAt tasmAt varastriyaH । utpeturmanujaSrezWa tasmAdapsaraso'Bavan” ॥)

m: अप्सरस्-तीर्थ n. a pool in which the Apsarasas bathe, Śāk.

v: tri॰ apsu apsADane tejasi sasti svapiti sasakvip 7 ta॰ । 1 rUpe tasya tejohetutvAt taTAtvam 2 rUpavati ca । “SIrzRA Siro'psasApso ardayannaM SUn baBasti hariteBirapsaBiH” a॰ 6, 49, 2, “jAyeva patya uSatI suvAsA uzA hasreva niriRIte apsaH” f॰ 1, 124, 7 ।
m: अप्सस् n. ‘the hidden part of the body’, the secret charms (of a wife), RV.; AV.; SV. [‘breast or κόλπος’, Gmn.; ‘cheek’, BR.; ‘forehead, face’, NBD.], hidden fault, sin, MaitrS.; Kāṭh.
(अप्स्वस्), KapS.
a: अप्सस् — n. Ved. Form, beauty; or one possessed of beauty; cheek (?).

v: tri॰ apsaM jalarasaM vAti hinasti vA--ka 6 ta॰ । jalarasaSUnye samudre tasya lavaRajalatvAttaTAtvam । “ye apsavamarRRavaM citrarADasasteno rAsantAm” f॰ 10, 65, 3 ।
m: अप्सव See s.v.
अप्-सव mfn. giving water, RV. x, 65, 3.
a: अप्सव — a. [अप्सं जलरसं वाति हिनास्ति, वा-क] Devoid of the essence (freshness) of water; possessed of form or shape; giving water (?)

v: pu॰ apsuBavaH “apoyoniyanmatupaH” vArtti॰ saptamyA aluk, yacca । jalaBave ।
m: अप्सव्य See s.v.
अप्सव्य mfn. (fr. 2. अप्सु, q.v.), being in the water (Varuṇa), MaitrS.; Kāṭh.
cf. Pāṇ. vi, 3, 1 Comm.
a: अप्सव्य — a. [अप्सु भवः यत्] Being in, or fit for, water.

v: tri॰ nAsti psu rUpam (niruktoktam) yasya । rUparahite “mA tvA vayaM sahasAvannavIrA mApsavaH pari” f॰ 7, 4, 6, apsavaH rUparahitAH” BA॰ । aprASastye na॰ ba॰ । apraSastarUpe asure, “apsujitaH” apsujicCabde dfSyam ।
m: अप्सु for words beginning thus, see s.v. अप्सु.
1. अ-प्सु mfn. without food, RV. vii, 4, 6.
2. अप्सु (loc. pl. of 2. अप्, q.v.), in the water or waters.
a: अप्सु — a. [नास्ति प्सु रूपं यस्य Nir.] 1 Formless, shapeless. --2 Not beautiful. Note --अप्सु forms the first member of several compounds. --क्षित् a god. --चर a. aquatic; moving in waters. --ज, --जा a. born in the waters or in the atmosphere. (--जाः) --योनिः {1} a horse. {2} a cane or reed. --जित् vanquishing the aerial Asuras. --मत् a. possessed of what is in water; not losing one's nature in water (as lightning); getting sufficient water.

v: tri॰ apsu caratIti cara--wa alukUsamA॰ striyAM NIp । jalacare ।
m: अप्सु—चर mfn. (Ved.) going in the waters, Pāṇ. vi, 3, 1 Comm.
अप्सु—दीक्षा f. consecration in water.
अप्सु—होम्य m. N. of a man, MBh. ii, 107.

v: pu॰ apsu--jAyate jana + viw aluksa॰ । aSve “amftAbAzpato vahnervedeByo'RqAcca garBataH । sAmnohayAnAmutpattiH saptaDA parikIrttitA” ityuktestasya bAzpajAtatvAttaTAtvam “saMSito apsvapsujA brahmA soma purogavaH” ya॰ 23, 14, “apsujA aSva” iti vedadI॰ । 2 vetase tasya jalasamIpajAtatvAt taTAtvam “apsuyornirvA aSvo'psujA vetasa” iti Sata॰ brA॰ । 3 jalajAtamAtre tri॰ ।
tri॰ apsujale tadDetO antarikze vA jAyate jana--qa aluksa॰ । 1 jalajAte 2 antarikzajAte “yadagne! divijA apsvapsujAH” iti f॰ 8, 43, 28, “apsujA antarikzajAtA” iti BA॰ ।
m: अप्सु—ज [TS.] or अप्सु—जा [RV. viii, 43, 28, &c.], mfn. born in the waters.

v: tri॰ apsUn asurAn jayati ji--kvip aluksamA॰ । antarikzasTAsurajetari “supAraH SuSravastamaH samapsujitaH” f॰ 8, 13, 2, “apsujitaH antarikzavarttamAnAnAmasurARAM jetAraH” BA॰ ।
m: अप्सु—जित् mfn. vanquishing among the waters or in the region of the clouds (N. of Indra), RV.

v: tri॰ apsu jalADAre antarikze kziyati nivasati--kzi--kvip aluksa॰ । antarikzavAsini devAdO “ye devAso divyekAdaSa sTa pfTivyAmekAdaSa sTa apsukzito mahinEkAdaSa f॰ 1, 139, 11, ya॰ 18, 9, ca “tadDetutvAt tAtsTyam apsu antarikze kziyanti nivasantIti” BA॰ ।
m: अप्सु—क्षित् mfn. dwelling within the clouds, in the region between heaven and earth, RV. i, 139, 11.

v: tri॰ apsu ApaH jalAni santyasya “apoyoniyanmatupaH” vArti॰ saptamyA matup aluksa॰ ca । 1 jalasaMpfkte ADArajyaBAge । “apsumantAvADArAjyaBAgAviti” si॰ kO॰ । 2 yaTezwaM UlalabDari ca “na hApsu prEtyapsumAn Bavati, CA॰ upa॰ । marusTalIzvapi yaTezwodakavAn BavatIti” AnandagiriH ।
m: अप्सु—मत् mfn. possessed of or shining in the waters (e.g. the lightning which does not lose its brilliant nature in the clouds), MaitrS. &c.
having always water, ChUp.
containing the word अप्सु, ŚBr.
N. of an Agni, ĀpŚr.

v: pu॰ adByaH saMSitaH vi॰ vya॰ aluksamA॰ jalanimittaBUte vizRukrame'ntarIkze “vizRoH kramo'si sapatnamapsusaMSito varuRatejAH” aTa॰ 10, 5, 33, ।
m: अप्सु—संशित (अप्सु-) mfn. raised or excited in the waters, AV. x, 5, 33.
अप्सु—वह् m(nom. pl. -वाहस्)fn. driving in water, SV.

v: pu॰ 7 ta॰ aluksamA॰ । jalezu yoge । “jizRave yogAyApsuyogErvoyunajmi” aTa॰ 10, 7, 5 ।
m: अप्सु—योग m. the connecting power in water, AV. x, 5, 5.

v: tri॰ apsu yonirutpattirasya alukusamA॰ । 1 jalaBave 2 aSve pu॰ “apsuyonirvA'SvaH” iti Sata॰ brA॰ । jalajatvamaSvasya apsujASabde uktam ।
m: अप्सु—योनि (अप्सु-) mfn. born from the waters, TS.; ŚBr.

v: tri॰ apsu jale kAraRatvena sIdati sada--kvip vede zatvam । jalasTe agnO “candramagniM candraraTaM harivrataM vESvAnaramapsuzadam” f॰ 6, 3, 5 ।
m: अप्सु—षद् mfn. dwelling in the waters, RV. iii, 3, 5; AV.; VS.
अप्सु—षदस् n. dwelling in the waters, MaitrS.

v: pu॰ apsu adBiH soma iva pavitratvAt “supAM su” pA॰ vyatyayena saptamI aluksamA॰ vede zatvam । jalapUrRe camasaH Bede “apsuzomAnAma camasAScAtvAladeSe adBiH pUrRA” iti tA॰ brA॰ drAhyAyaRasUtram । “pUrRapAtrAn samavamfSanti yAneke'psu zomA ityAcakzate” Sata॰ brA॰ ।
m: अप्सु—षोम m. ‘Soma in water’, a cup filled with water, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
